title: NEON ground beetles from pitfall traps, RELEASE-2026: carabid individuals of 55 species per trap-bout sample at 2029 traps across 47 NEON sites, 2013-2023
creator: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network)
citation: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network). Ground beetles sampled from pitfall traps (DP1.10022.001), RELEASE-2026. https://doi.org/10.48443/q9ne-6b77. Dataset accessed from https://data.neonscience.org/data-products/DP1.10022.001/RELEASE-2026 on 2026-11-02
abstract: NEON's ground beetle survey: pitfall traps (propylene glycol cups) at 10 plots per terrestrial site, four traps per plot through 2017 and three from 2018, collected every two weeks through the growing season; every carabid in a sample is sorted and identified to species or morphospecies by NEON technicians. This table is the number of carabid individuals of each species per trap-bout sample for the 55 species with at least 1000 individuals over the release; every shipped species carries a row at every collected sample. Unit coordinates are the plot centres NEON publishes.
samplingProtocol: Pitfall traps (16 oz cups, 150-250 mL propylene glycol) ~20 m from plot centre in the cardinal directions, set for ~14 days (trappingDays recorded per trap), collected biweekly when temperatures exceed 4 C; carabids sorted and identified in the domain lab, a pinned subset re-identified by a parataxonomist and an expert (NEON TOS protocol for ground beetle sampling)
surveyEvidenceNote: bet_fielddata lists every trap-bout; a survey exists iff sampleCollected == Y and samplingImpractical is OK or blank. A collected sample with no carabid rows in bet_sorting is y = 0 for every species. Species pool is national: every shipped species at every collected sample.
closureNote: occasion = biweekly bout within the growing season, indexed within the site-year by first collection date; period = calendar year
geographicCoverage: 47 NEON terrestrial sites in 20 domains, continental USA, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico; plot-centre coordinates as published by NEON (WGS 84) in __units; latitude 18.0 to 71.3, longitude -156.6 to -66.8

coordinatesCoarsened.method: As published by NEON (agency-published plot-centre coordinates with coordinateUncertaintyInMeters); no coarsening

covariateNote: obs_trapping_days is the decimal days the trap was open (effort); obs_cup_status and obs_fluid_level are the trap's condition at collection (NEON categorical values as published). Trap-level facts (site, domain, plot, trap, NEON namedLocation, plot type, NLCD class, plot-centre coordinates shared by a plot's traps, coordinate uncertainty, elevation) are in __units.
notes: Taxa: the 55 carabid species with >= 1000 individuals over the release, subspecies rolled up to the species; 644 species below the cut are listed in notShipped. y uses NEON's sorting-level identifications (where the counts are); a pinned subset is re-identified by a parataxonomist and an expert taxonomist, and the share that differ is reported in the build log, not applied. Surveys: collected samples under OK conditions with trappingDays > 0 (34 collected samples with samplingImpractical != OK and 3 with zero days dropped; 33 trap-bouts collected twice keep the first record; 22 rows with a placeholder eventID re-keyed to the site's bout that day or dropped). Counts include the 'other carabid' sorting rows (carabids recovered from the bycatch fraction, 1481 rows) and 1 sorting row(s) without individualCount are dropped. Period = calendar year; occasion = bout index within the site-year (max 17), so sites with short seasons have fewer occasions.
